lines.say: [dramatic] What if one skill could make the whole video?
lines.caption: What if one skill could make the whole video?

lines.say: It writes the script, gives it a voice, scores the music, and renders every frame on your GPU.
And the voice? It actually feels things.
[whispering] It can whisper you a secret...
lines.caption: It can whisper you a secret...

lines.say: [dramatic] Or tell a story like it truly means it.
lines.caption: Or tell a story like it truly means it.

lines.say: Every line is heard back by speech recognition. If a single word slips, aria says it again.
Then each caption lands on the exact word you hear.
Scenes are just React and TypeScript. Three D, motion graphics, music, all in code.
lines.caption: Scenes are just React and TypeScript. 3D, motion graphics, music, all in code.

lines.say: One command takes it from script, to voice, to render, to a checked, share ready file.
[happy] Everything you just saw and heard was made with the aria skill.
lines.caption: Everything you just saw and heard was made with the aria skill.

lines.say: Grab it on GitHub, and make something wild.
